principles.title: Deterministic core, AI shell
principles.text: Code owns calculations, invariants, and permissions. AI helps research, explain, draft, and review — it does not invent the numbers.

principles.title: Claims need evidence
principles.text: Every important claim on this site carries a label: repository evidence, public evidence, owner confirmed, demo, planned, or private. Released, prototyped, and planned work are different claims.

principles.title: Humans approve consequences
principles.text: Models can recommend; people remain accountable. Deployment, money, contracts, privacy, and public claims always pass through a human decision.

principles.title: Design for real context
principles.text: Low-resource Khmer data, field operations, connectivity, and user trust are product constraints — not edge cases to patch later.

principles.title: Small testable systems first
principles.text: Validate the riskiest assumption with the smallest working system before building the architecture the idea might one day deserve.
